text:
ash (eng-platform): Heads up — planning an A/B rollout for reranker_v2. Proposed plan: start 2% canary -> 10% -> 50% over ~24h. Need guardrails + explicit stopping rules before I create the experiment in Console.

marta: thanks. are we limiting by region or customer tier? don't want to hit enterprise SLA customers.

ash (eng-platform): good call — NA + EU only, exclude Enterprise orgs and test accounts. also exclude requests with explicit low-latency flags.

kevin: what are the primary metrics? conversion, and any quality evals? also what windows for stats (1m/5m/1h)?

ash (eng-platform): primary: query_success_rate (conversion), safety error rate, infra_error_rate. secondary: delta in p95 latency and tokens-per-request. use 1h rolling windows for stopping rules but surface 15m/5m for alerting.

ryan: can we enable extra logging / eval traces for ~0.1% of canary to run the new reranker against the golden reranker for quality diffs?

ash (eng-platform): yes — will enable paired-eval sampling for 0.1% and attach eval ids to the experiment.

sarah: i'll own monitoring for first 24h and will post updates in #incidents if anything spikes. set me as on-call for alerts.

eva: should we add a hard stop if error rate increases by X absolute or Y relative? happy to suggest numbers.

ash (eng-platform): propose stop rules: absolute infra_error_rate increase > 1 percentage point OR relative increase > 20% over baseline (1h smoothed). also stop if p95 latency increases > 150ms absolute, or conversion drops > 2% absolute. if any of these hit, auto-rollback to reranker_v1.

kevin: fine but let's add a safety margin for low-volume slices — require at least 2000 requests in the window before triggering. prevents noisy flips.

ash (eng-platform): agreed — add min_sample_size = 2000 per metric window.

marta: what's the rollout staging schedule?

ash (eng-platform): plan: stage 1 = 2% for 6h, stage 2 = 10% for 18h, stage 3 = 50% for 24h (if all guardrails pass). manual hold between stages for ops review.

ash (eng-platform): flag config (draft):
```json
{
  "flag": "reranker_v2",
  "audience": { "regions": ["NA","EU"], "exclude_tiers": ["enterprise"], "percent": 2 },
  "stages": [
    { "percent": 2,  "duration": "6h" },
    { "percent": 10, "duration": "18h" },
    { "percent": 50, "duration": "24h" }
  ],
  "stop_rules": {
    "infra_error_rate": { "abs_threshold": 0.01, "rel_threshold": 0.2 },
    "p95_latency_ms": 150,
    "conversion_drop_abs": 0.02,
    "min_sample_size": 2000
  }
}
```

ryan: looks good. please add a note to exclude corporate test traffic (we've had noisy bots cause false positives).

ash (eng-platform): will add exclude filters for known test tokens and internal IP ranges.

sarah: once you create the experiment tag me and i'll start the dashboard and PagerDuty rules.

deploy-bot: Experiment created: EXP-342-reranker_v2 (https://console.redwood.ai/experiments/EXP-342) by ash — initial stage 2% NA/EU excluding Enterprise.

marta: lgtm. i'll run a quick canary smoke test once 2% is live. :thumbsup:

kevin: i'll double-check the alert thresholds in monitoring and add a 15m alert for p95 and error spikes.

ash (eng-platform): thanks all — will update here as stages progress.
